_format: Global, reusable catalog of notable furniture/decor landmarks per tile side, shared across all scenarios in this project (same convention as doors.md for wall openness). Keys are the side= value from tiles.ini. Coordinates are LOCAL, unrotated (the .dds image as-is, top-left corner = origin, x grows right, y grows downward-but-negative -- same convention as geometry.md and tile_box() in validate_scenario.py: the tile occupies x in [0,width], y in [-height,0]). Each entry: name (short tag), box [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax] in squares, note. Boxes are deliberately generous/approximate (eyeballed from a grid-overlay preview image, not pixel-measured) and only cover clearly chunky furniture/fixtures -- thin wall trim, baseboards, and small hanging picture frames are generally NOT catalogued unless they were big enough to matter for a real placement decision. Confidence is 'eyeballed', not pixel-verified -- treat validate_scenario.py's landmark warning as a prompt to look at the tile_door_preview.py image yourself, not as ground truth.
